author: tomas-okafor
title: Review of PR 98: reason codes look right, one question on duplicates
body:
Looks good overall. I like that the matcher never writes to the ledger.

One question: for `duplicate_reference`, do we keep both lines in the exceptions table or only the second one? If a human has to resolve it they will want to see both side by side.

Not blocking, can be a follow-up.
